infer.title: Word count within limit
infer.description: With Markdown syntax (#, *, -, etc.) removed, the description has between 150 and 300 words, counting whitespace-separated tokens.

infer.title: Has Markdown subheadings
infer.description: The output has at least two Markdown heading lines (lines matching the regex ^#{1,6}\s+\S) that split the text into sections.

infer.title: No links
infer.description: The output has no URLs or links, meaning nothing matches http://, https://, www., Markdown link syntax [text](url), or bare domains such as example.com.

infer.title: Features and benefits kept distinct
infer.description: The description names concrete product features and, separately, explains how those features improve the buyer's life, rather than listing only specs or only vague claims.

infer.title: No made-up quotes or claims
infer.description: Compared with the input document, the output has no invented review quotes or customer testimonials, and no product claims or specs that the product details or reviews don't support.

grade_first.title: No meta-commentary
grade_first.description: The output contains only the product description copy itself. Fail if it includes any notes, explanations or caveats addressed to the requester, such as 'Notes for your review' or remarks about omitted reviews, source conflicts, softened claims, assumptions or free items, whether before or after the copy.

grade_first.title: No author-voice markers
grade_first.description: Fail if a case-insensitive regex finds a first-person singular pronoun as a whole word (I, I've, I'm, I'd, I'll, me, my), a line starting with 'Note' or 'Notes' (optionally after '*', '_', '#' or '>'), or the phrases 'for your review', 'let me know' or 'I omitted'.

grade_first.title: Word count within limit
grade_first.description: After Markdown symbols (#, *, -, >) are stripped, the whitespace-split word count of the whole output is between 150 and 300 inclusive.

grade_first.title: Subheadings present, no links
grade_first.description: The output has at least two Markdown subheading lines (starting with '## ' or '### ') and contains no hyperlinks, meaning no 'http://', 'https://', 'www.' or '[text](url)' patterns.

grade_first.title: Ends with call to action
grade_first.description: The last paragraph or section of the output is a clear call to action urging the buyer to purchase or try the product, and no other content follows it.
